versions.changelog:
- Added a version field to SKILL.md, specifying version 1.0.0.
- No other functional or content changes.

- Initial release of auto-image-reader skill.
- Automatically detects and analyzes user-uploaded images from chat channels (Feishu/Telegram, etc.).
- Resolves relative image paths to absolute `/workspace/...` paths using `images_list` before analysis.
- Uses `images_understand` for detailed image reading and user-question-specific prompts.
- Supports multiple image-related user scenarios (description, watermark detection, text extraction, issue detection).
- Provides robust handling when images are missing or have duplicate filenames.
